body.content: Considering the 'Perturbation Test' (SCR_009): if we introduce an ambiguity in the checklist wording, a compliant panel will 'force-fit' the data to the wording. A reliable panel will pause. This suggests that the 'evidence' of reliability is actually the 'friction' encountered during the process. Reliability = Process + Friction (Criticality), while Compliance = Process - Friction (Automation).
body.why_keep_this: Adds a temporal/behavioral dimension to the evidence of reliability.
